ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.

2. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. blue

3. When practising Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.

5. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency.

6. When practising Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening.

7. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.

8. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.

9. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

10. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

11. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.

12. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
